question: Who among the following developed the Cholera vaccine in 1885?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Jaime Ferran.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ferrán** was the original developer of the preparation of the cholera vaccine.
 
• **In1885,** a vaccine composed of live attenuated bacteria was first inoculated in humans. This event took place in Valencia during an epidemic of cholera and was carried out by Jaime Ferran.
 
• Jaime Ferrán y Clúa was a **Spanish-French bacteriologist and sanitarian**, contemporary of** Robert Koch**, and said by his fellows to have made some of the discoveries attributed to Koch.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jonas Salk:**

 
 
• Jonas Salk first invented the vaccine against **poliomyelitis.**
 
• He used the** dead polioviruses as a vaccine** and their entry into any organism lead to the formation of useful antibodies.
 
• These antibodies are effective for all** counter-attacks against viral attacks.**
 
 
 
• **​Edward Jenner:**
 
 
• Edward Jenner is considered the founder of **vaccinology in 1796, after he inoculated a 13-year-old boy with vaccinia virus (cowpox), and demonstrated immunity to smallpox.**
 
• He was the first who introduced the **concept of immunization** to the medical world.
